notes.title: 【Demo Version Discontinuation Announcement】
notes.content:
[h1]The demo version of Triopticon will remain available for download on Steam until 02/01, and the demo version of Project Aphotic will remain available until 03/01. [/h1]
[h2]After these dates, both demo versions will no longer be accessible. The full versions of the games are unaffected, and all future updates and maintenance will focus on the full versions.[/h2]

[h2]This decision to discontinue the demo versions is aimed at keeping the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/DarkChillDusk2024]DCD Dark Chill Dusk developer page [/url]more streamlined. Moving forward, only demo versions of games still in development will be retained.[/h2]

notes.title: "Project Aphotic" Set to Officially Launch on November 22, 2024
notes.content:
Dear all,

[h1][b]Our BL visual novel game, Project Aphotic, is scheduled to officially release on November 22, 2024 on Steam.[/b][/h1]
 
What’s the truth behind Lucien's amnesia? How will Lucien and Hugh’s relationship develop? All will be revealed in the full version.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44814580/9fb6691762d0410c21d415dc2f5017a63b21f803.png[/img]

In addition to the characters you already know—Lucien, Hugh, and Ceto—new characters will also make their appearance in the story.
How will their presence affect the dynamics between the three at Lab A?

Lastly, a reminder that the free demo of Project Aphotic is now available on Steam, allowing you to experience the first three chapters of the story.
Add Project Aphotic to your wishlist today and get ready for the official launch on November 22!
